nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Good governance|Rule-based governance systems_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What types of rules influence interactions between actors?
nodes.answer: Interactions between actors are influenced by formal rules (such as laws, property rights, and policies) and informal rules (such as customs and norms).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Good governance|Rule-based governance systems_qna_001
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Why is an institutional perspective important in the context described?
nodes.answer: An institutional perspective is important because it highlights the rules that influence how actors behave and the conditions under which they make their choices.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Governance|Peace, justice and strong institutions|Good governance|Rule-based governance systems_qna_002
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Why is it important to go beyond rules on paper or institutional design in governance?
nodes.answer: It is important to address governance elements in action and interactions of actors rather than just relying on formal rules and structures.
